propositions: Recursive tests/**/conftest.py pattern in global_support causes unrelated nested conftest changes to select all seven mutation shards, wasting 322.6 runner-minutes across 97 recent Verify runs without loading those fixtures.

Runtime tracing of every configured shard revealed pytest loads exactly six conftests in ancestor chains, not sibling fixture trees, enabling dependency-accurate selection instead of global invalidation.
Per-shard support mapping assigns each non-root ancestor conftest only to shards whose configured tests load it, with tests/conftest.py remaining the sole true global conftest.

A derived ancestry equality contract expands configured test paths, derives their present ancestor conftests, and asserts per-shard manifest support closure matches the derived set while pinning all existing mappings.
Contract defect-seeding proves fail-closed drift by observing RED on missing or stale conftest entries and GREEN when dependencies are correctly mapped.
